en: Color photograph of a large Romanesque cathedral dominating a town square. The church has pale stone walls, a tall octagonal dome-tower topped with a cross, an ornate façade with a large rose window, and an attached porch with arches and columns. Adjacent buildings have medieval stonework and crenellations. Several 1960s–1970s European cars are parked in the open square in front. Mountains rise in the background under a clear blue sky.
